text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Paraneoplastic Pemphigus secondary to underlying malignancy (likely non-Hodgkin lymphoma or Castleman disease). The combination of severe mucosal involvement, skin rash, and respiratory symptoms without constitutional "B symptoms" strongly suggests a paraneoplastic syndrome rather than primary autoimmune disease or nutritional deficiency.
